summary: Quetta Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K reporting the termination of material promissory notes totaling $1,040,000 held by KM Quad. The notes were irrevocably discharged and cancelled; no amounts remain due. This is a debt release connected to a prior termination agreement. No acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation is present—this is a routine debt discharge filing by a blank-check company.
